title: Chapter 212 Cultivate The Ministers
content:
Chapter 212 Cultivate The Ministers

Cao Cao was startled when he heard that the man in front of him, who was extremely powerful and powerful, looked at him with some teasing. But then he was pleasantly surprised by what he said, and joy appeared on his face, subverting his usual cunning and cunning.

"Is Your Majesty willing to..." Cao Cao tentatively hesitated.

"Okay, stop teasing Aiqing, there's nothing wrong with it, I'm really willing to spend a little bit of luck to help many civil and military ministers and elite soldiers in my imperial kingdom practice and improve their strength!" Laughed a few times , Zhong Yu felt a little relieved, it was indeed a joy in life to make a generation of treacherous Cao Cao so careful.

"However, I heard that these lucks are extremely important to His Majesty, and they are the foundation of maintaining our country and me. Will it have some impact if he is given to my ministers to use? Ten thousand deaths will not atone for their sins!" Hearing that His Majesty is really willing to give up his luck to cultivate for people like himself, although Cao Cao was happy, he still couldn't help persuading him out of his duty as a courtier.

Zhong Yu's eyes twitched, and he looked at Cao Cao unexpectedly. In his impression, Cao Cao has always been a cunning person who will do anything to achieve his goals.

In the past, Cao Cao's methods of doing things in order to achieve his orders were indeed extremely cruel, and he did not live up to his reputation as a traitor.

Now Zhong Yu finally realized that this Cao Cao was not a time when all the heroes came together, after being tempted by power and tempered in every possible way, he grew up as a traitor, with infinite ambition ignited in his heart, and he no longer had the desire to be inferior to others the cunning generation.

When this Cao Cao was just young, the big man became a big royal, and Cao Cao also changed from a Han minister to a royal minister. Although he was a little sad, the big man perished. But he quickly accepted himself as a subject of another country.

And because of this identity, Cao Cao is actively loyal to himself, and contributes every ounce of his strength to the rise of Yuguo. It can be said that he is loyal to the country and has devoted himself to the country.

After thinking so much, Zhong Yu felt a little emotional. He used to look at the ministers under his command with colored glasses, and he was still a bit biased in some respects.

"Don't worry, Aiqing, you have devoted so much heart and effort to the rise of the empire, what is a little loss of luck?" Zhong Yu's face was full of emotion, and his tone Feeling a little moved, he comforted Cao Cao.

"Your Majesty..." Cao Cao looked at Zhong Yu moved, a little surprised, he did not expect that the emperor, who was always ruthless in the hearts of him and his officials, would make such comforting words.

"Okay, Ai Qing doesn't have to be like this. Besides, these luck points are not all wasted. The strength you have cultivated after absorbing it is not the strength of our imperial country? With the help of you loyal courtiers, I can sit back and relax. Sit back and enjoy the peace, let you go and expand the territory for me!" With a few chuckles, Zhong Yu was very satisfied with Cao Cao's attitude, this is his good servant.

Afterwards, the two discussed about luck and how to deal with Qin's army. With a general direction, Cao Cao left.

...

Watching Cao Cao's leaving figure, Zhong Yu's eyes were dark, and there were a few golden lights flashing among them, bursting out with great power.

It has been nearly two years since he came to the world of Qin Shimingyue, and Zhong Yu's cultivation has never stopped, even though he spent a lot of luck points in that western world of gods and demons before, and his reserves have been exhausted .

But after coming to this world, he first killed tens of millions of people in the northern border, and then caused great turmoil in the seven southern countries. Millions of people died directly or indirectly because of him.

Among so many people, it is unknown how many people have reached the first level, or have cultivated the extraordinary power of internal skills. The luck they have accumulated is already extremely impressive, at least enough for him to practice.

The continuous supply of so much luck to Zhong Yu's cultivation naturally made his cultivation advance by leaps and bounds, and now he has reached the peak of the world, and he is only one step away from reaching the fifth level.

Zhong Yu has a premonition that if this war, he can achieve his goal, completely disturb the world's major events, and reverse the strength and destiny of Qin to unify the world.

At that time, with this general trend, he will be able to take advantage of the situation to break through the fifth level, which hinders all cultivators in the whole world.

As far as he knew, the current Donghuang Taiyi of the Yinyang family was only at the peak of the fourth rank, which was the same as Zhong Yu's current realm. Even to a certain extent, because Zhong Yuxiu's domineering internal energy is far superior to Donghuang Taiyi in terms of power.

He can be sure that in this world, as long as the illusory Nine Heavens Profound Girl does not appear in the legend, then his strength can be said to be the best in the world.

But now that he has cultivated to this point, his cultivation has fallen into a bottleneck, and it is difficult to make any progress, and those lucks are temporarily useless.

As for the useless luck, it has been stored for such a long time, and after a few months, it has accumulated an extremely considerable amount of luck.

These lucks are kept and kept, instead of wasting them, it is better to use them and distribute them to those loyal courtiers to improve their strength. When they are stronger, the strength of Yuguo will also be stronger.

As for when Zhong Yu can break through, what should he do if he needs luck points?

At that time, Zhong Yu had already influenced the major destiny trajectory of this world, and he would definitely be able to let Heaven and Humanity spit out a large part of their luck, and if he extracted some of it, it would be enough for his own cultivation. There is even room to spare, which can be provided to more courtiers.

"However, what needs to be done now is to think about how to bring down Qin, and involve more countries, so that they can consume their strength together!" Coldly spit out this sentence, Zhong Yu's eyes flickered, and his whole body was full of excitement. There were bursts of killing intent.

Now relying on his own strength alone, even if Yu Guo and South Korea are added, he is definitely not the opponent of Qin State today. Not only Cao Cao knows this, but Zhong Yu also understands this.

So what to do? Since your own strength is not enough, then find a few more allies and form a joint vertical alliance yourself, isn't that what it is for?

"Now, in the Three Kingdoms of Zhao, Wei and Chu, I help them to entangle Qin's positive pressure. They have eaten so much fat from Qin, and finally let them grow up. But I didn't do things for them for nothing. It's time Let them come out and contribute their part!" With a sneer, Zhong Yu looked in the direction of these countries.
